sources.entry: llama-index - A toolkit for building RAG pipelines and agents over your data.
LlamaIndex - LlamaIndex is a data framework for your LLM applications

summary.one_liner: LlamaIndex is an open-source Python framework (the llama-index / llama-index-core packages) for building RAG and agent applications over your own data, maintained by the LlamaIndex company, which now focuses mainly on its LlamaParse document platform.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a modular Python framework split into a core package (llama-index-core) and a large set of separate integration packages for LLMs, embedding models, and vector stores (over 300 are mentioned). It offers data connectors for sources such as APIs, PDFs, docs, and SQL, and provides index structures (indices and graphs) to organize data for LLM use. It includes a query interface that retrieves context and feeds it to an LLM, with high-level APIs for quick starts and lower-level APIs for customizing modules like retrievers, query engines, and rerankers. Indexes are stored in memory by default and can be persisted to disk and reloaded. The README also notes the company's shift in focus toward LlamaParse, a separate commercial document parsing and extraction platform that can be used with or without the framework.
use_cases: build a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) app over private documents
ingest PDFs, docs, and SQL data for question answering with an LLM
create a vector store index and query it in a few lines of Python
swap between OpenAI, Ollama, and Hugging Face models and embeddings
build LLM agents that use custom tools and data
parse and extract structured data from documents via LlamaParse
stack: LlamaIndex integration packages (LLMs, embeddings, vector stores)
notable: Namespaced package layout: imports with 'core' come from the core package, others from integration packages
Starter package (llama-index) or a customized install of core plus chosen integrations
Default in-memory storage with persist and reload to ./storage
Build assets in the core package can be verified with GitHub attestation (gh attestation verify)
Ships a bundled _static folder with nltk and tiktoken caches for restricted environments
caveats: The README says the company's primary focus has shifted to LlamaParse, and the OSS framework is presented as available but no longer the main focus
The README states it is not updated as frequently as the documentation
Many features (LlamaParse, LlamaAgents, Extract, Index) are part of a separate enterprise platform with signup and product links
